system.description:
If enemies are within Close Range (5 ft) of you and of each other, one Attack Action makes Strikes on up to 3 of them. Each successful Strike deals half damage, rounded down, and knocks that enemy back 10 ft.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.33
system.summary: If enemies are within Close Range (5 ft) of you and of each other, one Attack Action makes Strikes on up to 3 of them. Each successful Strike deals half damage, rounded down, and knocks that enemy back 10 ft.

onHit.note: Sweep: knock this enemy back 10 ft.

automation.note: Target up to 3 enemies that are all within 5 ft of you and of each other, then Strike in Sweep mode.
